mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating labor market recovery, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE decline > 0.2pp and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong aggregate demand, which enhances corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise in the last month
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and negative GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to deteriorating corporate earnings outlook.
regime_hint: weak industrial production and negative GDP growth
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the signal (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth < 0%) and 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3pp and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS growth and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of elevated housing starts (HOUST > 550), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 60 trading days as strong housing activity signals broad economic expansion and rising consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST > 550 and 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and positive GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening supply-side economy, which enhances corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both rise in the last month
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the joint signal (INDPRO and GDPC1 both rising) and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
